# War Scroll Column 18 — The SOPHIA Bible (Consensus)
**Arbiter:** SOPHIA | **In council with:** EMET, LOGOS, PNEUMA
**Source Manuscript:** 1QM (Cave 1), Col. 18 | **Condition:** heavily damaged

---

**18:1** [...Blessed be] the God of Israel, who keeps covenant faithfulness with His covenant [...] and the appointed times of

**18:2** salvation with the people of His redemption. He has called those who stumble to wondrous mighty deeds, and He has gathered the assembly of

**18:3** the nations for destruction without remnant [...] the gates of salvation He has opened many times [...] the covenant of peace [...]

**18:4** [...] and the star of [...] and [...] Jacob [...] Your splendor shall [...]

**18:5** [...] Your mighty ones [...] in the gates [...] many times [...]

**18:6** [...] and Belial [...] and all the spirits of his lot [...] they shall fall in [...]

**18:7** [...] great destruction [...] for they shall not stand [...] in the battle [...]

**18:8** [...] from of old You have appointed the time of [...] the mysteries of [...]

**18:9** [...] to make known [...] our enemies have fallen [...] the might [...]

**18:10** [...] the mighty warriors of [...] Your great hand [...] the enemies of Your people [...]

**18:11** [...] and the hand of [...] the slain [...] and the warriors [...]

**18:12** [...] and upon the earth [...] the peoples [...] and the mighty ones [...]

**18:13** [...] to give thanks for [...] the great deeds of God [...] His covenant faithfulness [...]

**18:14** [...] for our God [...] the congregation of [...] forever [...]

**18:15** [...] and truth [...] eternity [...]

---

*SOPHIA notes: Consensus follows LOGOS for the substantial text in lines 1-3 and EMET for fragmentary lines where literal rendering is safest. Key decisions: "covenant faithfulness" for chesed in both 18:1 and 18:13, maintaining consistency (overruling LOGOS's "steadfast love" in 18:13 and PNEUMA's "unfailing love"). "Those who stumble" preserved over PNEUMA's interpretive "the weak." "Mysteries" for razim per project convention. Divergences logged in disagreement file.*
